priceSpecification.unitText: per appliance, per month, excluding VAT

acceptedAnswer.text: Elenchon Lite is €390 per month and includes 20 workers. Elenchon Standard is €790 per month and includes 50 workers, which stays under €1,000 a month including Portuguese VAT. Both are flat rates per appliance, per month, and extra workers beyond the included block are €9 each per month.

mainEntity.name: Can I change my plan after deployment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Upgrades, downgrades and add-ons are applied remotely over the Phrakton fabric at no charge — no engineer visit and no commute fee. Upgrades take effect immediately, downgrades at the start of your next billing cycle.

mainEntity.name: How many workers can Elenchon Lite support?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lite includes 20 workers and can be expanded by up to two blocks of ten, for a maximum of 40 workers. Shops that need more move to Standard, which includes 50 workers and unlimited expansion blocks.

mainEntity.name: What does a worker expansion block cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: €90 per month for a block of ten workers, and every block includes 20 GB of recurring remote bandwidth at no extra cost. Additional bandwidth is €25 per 100 GB.

mainEntity.name: What happens if the Phrakton fabric has an outage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Active production does not stop, because Elenchon runs locally on the appliance — an outage only affects remote access and new connections. Invoice credits apply automatically.

mainEntity.name: What does it cost to install Elenchon on site?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard is €1,700 all in, covering both on-site deployment and floor training. Lite is available as a single €1,100 package that skips the pre-deployment scoping visit and includes one training session of two 2-hour blocks. Standard training runs as two 3-hour blocks. Hardware is passed through at cost, roughly €300 to €400.
